notes.title: Crypto Shooter Demo play session with developer
notes.content:
Crypto Shooter Demo, developer Live Playing Bot Capture Mode, Crypto Shooter is an action filled first person shooter with blockchain-based tokenized statistics and rewards.

Capture Enemy Bots by knocking them out. You can see your team color indicated on the line on the lower part of the screen. You get points for all kills by you and your captured team Bots. Enemy Bots killed by you respawn in your team.
